name: 无糖果味气泡水畅饮款
description: 整箱主图到场景背书的粉调气泡水套组，主张与证据位全占位

styleLock.direction: playful premium flavored sparkling water ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for the packshot, flat glossy pink #F2A3C0 panels for every graphic shot, deep crimson #A8122C and dark plum #3D1B45 fields for the macro, scene and close, each graphic panel finished with a thin crimson and plum footer stripe
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, crisp specular streak on the chilled bottle wall, fine condensation, soft contact shadow only, no harsh cast shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white seamless sweep for packshots, glossy pink acrylic sheet dotted with water droplets for graphic shots, dark plum matte slate for the scene
styleLock.typography: one bold condensed geometric sans-serif for headlines plus one lighter companion sans for short proof lines, in-image copy always carried as placeholder tokens, never source sentences
styleLock.iconSystem: flat single-color thin-line pictograms plus empty shield and seal outlines, one glyph per idea, no shading, no embedded marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the bottle keeps a stable upright or boldly diagonal stance at consistent scale, the label field stays an untouched blank plane, berries and ice appear only as corner garnish and never cover the label
noDrift: no invented numbers, percentages or badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful-premium flavored sparkling water ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, glossy pink #F2A3C0, deep crimson #A8122C and dark plum #3D1B45; bright even high-key neutral studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, crisp specular streak on the chilled bottle and soft contact shadows; seamless flat color panels finished with a thin crimson and plum footer stripe; one bold condensed geometric sans-serif for headlines paired with one lighter companion sans, never mixed with other families; flat single-color thin-line pictograms and empty badge outlines only; stable bottle scale and label-forward placement across all shots; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers or badges.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼点开，用整箱托盘加单瓶并列建立家庭装的量感与主体形态。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, blank shipper tray of identical units at back left and one upright unit front right, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadows under every unit
shots.props: one unprinted kraft shipper tray only
shots.whitespace: clean even margin around the silhouette, no extra whitespace inside
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view: a blank unprinted shipper tray holding a row of identical units at the back left, one upright unit standing front right of it, full product visible and never clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, soft contact shadows grounding every unit on the surface. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame with a clean even margin around the silhouette. 4K commercial beverage ecommerce quality. Negative: no readable words or digits on tray or labels, no pack count and no volume numbers, no barcodes, no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no gradient background, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size.

shots.intent: 一秒法则传递首要购买理由，用斜放瓶身和右侧大块留白承接主张与佐证。

shots.lighting: bright neutral key from the upper left with soft fill, single crisp specular streak along the shoulder
shots.background: glossy flat pink panel #F2A3C0 scattered with chilled water droplets
shots.props: a few whole berries and one clear ice cube tucked into the corners as garnish
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the right 40% reserved for copy
shots.textZone: 右侧 40% 留白承接一条主张与一句佐证
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unit laid on a bold diagonal, photographed straight-on at eye level and framed from the cap to the lower body as a tight mid-shot, the label plane facing the camera and kept untouched. Glossy flat pink panel #F2A3C0 scattered with chilled water droplets, a few whole berries and one clear ice cube at the corners as garnish, never over the label. shots.intent: 用瓶壁冷凝水珠的微距质感证明冰镇清爽，替下任何口感文字主张。

shots.lighting: skimming soft light from the upper left sculpting each droplet, one controlled highlight
shots.background: deep crimson field #A8122C falling out of focus behind the glass line
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the droplet field runs to all four edges

Photographed at a clean 90-degree side profile of the wall with very shallow depth of field, foreground beads razor sharp and the label plane softly out of focus behind them. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底整箱运输托盘与单瓶并列的量感主图；002 粉底旋转排版的营养成分面板加整果溅汁；003 瓶身斜置、右侧大段口味故事文案；004 左侧瓶身加右侧三枚单色线性图标与盾牌轮廓；005 纯文字三组主副标题卖点面板；006 三种包装形态并列并按饮用时刻分层标注。品类判定：实物为 PET 瓶充气质饮，按图取 L1 食品饮料、L2 饮料，与给定的饮料路径提示一致，不因图内营养面板而误判为医药保健。结构处理：005 的纯文字面板与 003、004 的卖点结构合并为斜置主张镜与收口镜；004 的图标列拆为独立信任镜；006 的形态并列转为选款镜，其饮用时刻措辞另派生一镜深色桌面场景（源图无实拍生活场景，仅由该镜的场景分层措辞推导）。已剥离：原字标与系列名、口味名、瓶身与托盘上的全部原句文案、净含量与箱装支数等数值、热量与每日摄入百分比等营养成分数值、维生素与抗氧化等成分功效断言、畅销措辞、原平台角标与星级评分字样；上述位置一律改为 {selling_point_n} 与 {callout_n} 占位或空白证据位（空参数行、空数值列、空盾牌框、空印章框、空按钮框）。源图 001 为略横幅 1024x909，其余为 1024x1024，全套按 1:1 出图以贴合平台方图规范。
